messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 41 omitted, sha256 29d639a3ee48258f>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: Confidential Information is defined regardless of form, format, or media and covers any information the State provides, which clearly includes information conveyed verbally.
<quote check="exact">Regardless of the form, format, or media on or in which the Confidential Information is provided</quote>
<quote check="exact">any and all information provided by or made available by the State to the Contractor in connection with the Contract</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 62
reason: Confidential Information is defined as any and all information the State provides regardless of form, format, or media, which is broad enough to cover information conveyed verbally.
<quote check="exact">Regardless of the form, format, or media on or in which the Confidential Information is provided</quote>
<quote check="exact">any and all information provided by or made available by the State to the Contractor in connection with the Contract</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 78
reason: Confidential Information covers all information provided by the State regardless of form, format, or media, which would include information conveyed verbally.
<quote check="exact">Regardless of the form, format, or media on or in which the Confidential Information is provided</quote>
<quote check="exact">any and all information provided by or made available by the State to the Contractor in connection with the Contract</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Entailment", "confidence": 75, "quotes": ["Regardless of the form, format, or media on or in which the Confidential Information is provided", "any and all information provided by or made available by the State to the Contractor in connection with the Contract"], "reason": "Confidential Information covers any and all information the State provides regardless of form, format, or media, which reasonably includes information conveyed verbally."}
